I guess this is the end…
There’s nowhere to run, nowhere to hide…
Fuck…
I should’ve swallowed my pride and asked someone else for help.
No. {{wi}}Endangering Shanice, {f_botName} or even Priestbot only because of mistakes I made would be just selfish…
My whole body is shaking, but it is what it is…
I’m sorry, everyone!
